title: ALMA spectral line and imaging survey of a low and a high mass-loss rate AGB star between 335 and 362 GHz
question: What are the dominant physical, dynamical and chemical processes in the inner wind of the low mass-loss rate AGB star R Dor and the high mass-loss rate AGB star IK Tau, as traced by an ALMA band 7 spectral line and imaging survey?

data.sensitivity: Channel rms 3-9 mJy (IK Tau), 2.7-5.7 mJy (R Dor); continuum rms 0.047 mJy

what.value: Stellar and wind properties (D, L, T*, R*, Mdot, r_dust, v_inf) of both stars

evidence.quote: Overview of stellar and wind properties of R Dor and IK Tau (cite: Decin2017arXiv170405237D).
for an opacity of $\sim$7 cm$^2$/g (cite: Demyk2017arXiv170609801D)

what.value: Dust temperature ranges 200-650 K (IK Tau) and 400-1530 K (R Dor)

evidence.quote: dust temperature of varying between 200–650 K for IK Tau and 400–1530 K for R Dor (cite: Decin2017arXiv170405237D)

what.value: Spectral line catalogues for line identification

evidence.quote: spectral line catalogues of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (cite: Pickett1998JQSRT..60..883P) and the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and line cubes
recipe.method: Standard CASA calibration scripts, self-calibration on continuum channels, continuum subtraction, imaging of full cubes

recipe.goal: Derive dust mass and dust mass-loss rate from continuum
recipe.method: Subtract convolved stellar point source from continuum, convert the residual to dust mass assuming optically thin emission, and compute crossing time from the momentum equation solution
assumptions: Optically thin dust, opacity ~7 cm2/g, dust temperature 200-650 K (IK Tau) and 400-1530 K (R Dor)

recipe.method: Extract spectra in circular apertures, accept lines above 3x local rms, match with JPL/CDMS catalogues and the SMA VY CMa atlas, check with non-LTE spectra, fit soft-parabola to find blends

recipe.goal: Measure line widths, fluxes and angular extents
recipe.method: Velocity span as continuous extent above 3.5 sigma; zeroth-moment maps; angular extent from annuli down to 1.5x off-source rms; azimuthal averages
Intensity ratios of isotopologue lines with same quantum numbers, corrected for Einstein A / CDMS predicted intensity, frequency, partition function and lower energy
assumptions: Optically thin, LTE, no radiative pumping differences; masers excluded

recipe.method: Plot half-width at zero intensity versus half the spatial FWHM and compare with beta-law velocity profiles from literature
key_parameters: beta=1 (IK Tau), beta=5 (R Dor) from literature; beta=10 shown as guide
